notes:
{風呂敷|ふろしき} is a traditional square cloth used for wrapping and carrying objects.

ETYMOLOGY:
The name literally means "bath spread" - originally used to wrap clothes when visiting public baths (⟦{銭湯|せんとう}→銭湯：16032_sentou⟧).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {風呂敷|ふろしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{包|つつ}む→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧: to wrap in a furoshiki
- {風呂敷|ふろしき}⟦{包|づつ}み→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧: furoshiki bundle
- {風呂敷|ふろしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: to exaggerate, make grand claims
- ⟦{大|おお}→大：noentry⟧{風呂敷|ふろしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: to make big boasts

CULTURAL NOTE:
Recently revived as an eco-friendly alternative to plastic bags. Available in various sizes and patterns.
